answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities unprofitable by charging a sunk fee per identity, never refunded. Each applicant pays 50 units to join, and the fee climbs toward a zenith of 200 units, so a farmer planting 100 fakes in one orchard pays 100x50=5,000 units for a pool that pays only 30 per identity. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share, while fakes lose on every extra one. Each identity is checked once, like an opal graded before sale.
